fix(choices): use explicit check-before-push instead of Set spread

Per review feedback from @shadowspawn: replace the Set-based dedup
with a more readable check-before-push loop. Each value is only
appended if not already present in the existing array.

Before:
  this.#options[type][key] = [...new Set(existing.concat(value))]

  const existing = (this.#options[type][key] || []) as unknown[];
  for (const v of ([] as unknown[]).concat(value)) {
    if (!existing.includes(v)) existing.push(v);
  }
  this.#options[type][key] = existing as Options[T][K];

fix(choices): deduplicate when same value added multiple times

Multiple calls to `.choices(key, values)` with overlapping values
previously produced duplicate entries via a plain `.concat()`.

before assigning so each choice value appears at most once.

  .choices('color', ['red', 'green', 'blue'])
  .choices('color', ['blue', 'rainbow'])
  // => ['red', 'green', 'blue', 'blue', 'rainbow']

After:
  .choices('color', ['red', 'green', 'blue'])
  .choices('color', ['blue', 'rainbow'])
  // => ['red', 'green', 'blue', 'rainbow']
